seven_scroll_scenes.title: 01. NASCITA DELLA TERRA
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: Un Pianeta Infernale in Fusione
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: La Terra primitiva era un oceano di magma vulcanico sferzato da meteoriti, con un'atmosfera tossica ricca di anidride carbonica, vapore acqueo e azoto.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: Isometric lava terrain with boiling magma pools, volcanic vents, floating smoke clouds, glowing particle embers, orange-red point lights.

seven_scroll_scenes.title: 02. LA GRANDE OSSIDAZIONE
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: L'Alba dell'Oceano e dei Cianobatteri
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: I primi microorganismi fotosintetici (cianobatteri) iniziano a rilasciare ossigeno libero, trasformando la chimica degli oceani e precipitando il ferro disciolto.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: Cyan ocean waters with microbial mats, underwater bubbles rising, banded iron formation structures, oceanic sunlight rays.

seven_scroll_scenes.title: 03. CICLI GLACIALI E TERRA PALLA DI NEVE
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: I Ritmi Orbitali di Milankovitch
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: La Terra attraversa drammatiche ere glaciali alternate a periodi interglaciali, guidata dall'eccentricità dell'orbita terrestre e dai feedback dell'albedo polare.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: Isometric frozen ice sheet, crystalline glacier formations, drifting snow particles, pale blue frosty lighting, aurora borealis sky shaders.

seven_scroll_scenes.title: 04. PICCOLA L'ETÀ GLACIALE
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: I Fiumi Ghiacciati dell'Europa Medievale
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: La riduzione dell'attività solare (Minimo di Maunder) ed eruzioni vulcaniche portano a secoli di inverni rigidi con fiumi europei come il Tamigi e il Po completamente congelati.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: Low-poly medieval timber village with snow-covered roofs, frozen river, smoke from stone chimneys, pine trees in winter coat.

seven_scroll_scenes.title: 05. RIVOLUZIONE INDUSTRIALE
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: L'Inizio dell'Impronta Antropica
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: L'invenzione del motore a vapore e lo sfruttamento massiccio del carbone rilasciano nel ciclo del carbonio CO2 fossile rimasta intrappolata per centinaia di milioni di anni.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: Brick factory complexes, smoking industrial chimneys, mechanical steam gears turning, dark smoke plumes ascending into atmosphere.

seven_scroll_scenes.title: 06. LA SCIENZA DELL'EFFETTO SERRA
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: Da Fourier a Hansen: I Pionieri del Clima
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: Joseph Fourier (1824), Eunice Foote (1856), Svante Arrhenius (1896) e James Hansen (1988 alla NASA) dimostrano la fisica delle molecole di CO2 e CH4 nel trattenere il calore infrarosso.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: Abstract molecular grid of CO2 and H2O molecules absorbing thermal infrared photons, scientific data graphs floating in 3D space.

seven_scroll_scenes.title: 07. IL PIANETA CONTEMPORANEO
seven_scroll_scenes.subtitle: +1.1°C – +1.3°C Rispetto al Periodo Pre-Industriale
seven_scroll_scenes.scientific_summary: Gli attuali livelli di CO2 (oltre 420 ppm) causano un riscaldamento senza precedenti storici negli ultimi 2.000 anni, alterando correnti oceaniche e ghiacciai polari.
seven_scroll_scenes.visual_3d: High-detail isometric Earth globe with thermal gradient overlays (+1.3°C anomalies in red), extreme weather vortexes, real-time CO2 counters.

elements: Current Active Scene Badge (e.g. 'SCENA 03/07 - CICLI GLACIALI')

SceneScrollCanvas.description: Scroll-driven WebGL Canvas rendering isometric 3D scenes with camera transition interpolation, lighting changes, fog effects, and particle systems per scene.

TextRevealOverlay.description: Floating overlay positioned at bottom/side of screen so 3D content stays visible. Animated reveals using Framer Motion (bottom rise, opacity mask, staggered paragraphs).

InteractiveTimeline.description: Non-linear timeline scrubber modal/drawer allowing jumps to any era (4.5 Ga, 2.5 Ga, Ice Ages, Maunder Minimum, 1850, Science, 2026).

TextReadingRoute.description: Full-screen accessible reading mode presenting all 7 scenes as a rich structured scientific paper with interactive charts, references, and audio controls.

ModelGalleryViewer.description: Isolated interactive 3D model inspector modal where users select models (e.g. Magma Volcano, Cyanobacteria Cell, Glacial Ice Block, Steam Engine, CO2 Molecule, Digital Warming Globe) to orbit, zoom, pan, and read deep specs.

SoundEngine.description: Web Audio API procedural sound synthesizer producing ambient drones per scene and interaction click/hover SFX. Off by default.

SourcesSection.description: Footer section citing IPCC AR6, NASA Global Climate Change, NOAA Earth System Research Laboratories, and WMO climate records.

AdminDashboard.description: Protected admin area behind password login featuring interactive analytics charts (scene dropoffs, user scroll time, mode preferences) and real-time WebGL error log table.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a production-ready, fully interactive React 19 web application in Italian for 'EARTH THROUGH TIME' (Studio Rocchetti Comunicazione).

Ensure all 7 scenes are fully scroll-driven with smooth camera and 3D visual transitions. If WebGL context is lost or unsupported, gracefully fall back to procedural 2D/Canvas animated scenes without breaking UI.
Implement the exact user-provided color palette (#080B10, #101D30, #F4F7FA, #66D9EF, #FF7138, #FF4B45). Never use default generic bright blue.
Position text reveal overlays at bottom or side margins to NEVER obscure the core 3D scene focal point.

Include a visible header with: scene indicator, Timeline scrubber modal trigger, Sound on/off toggle (Web Audio API synth + interaction clicks), Reset View button, Text Route ('Modalità Lettura') toggle, 3D Model Gallery trigger, and Admin Login link.
Provide a full accessible Text Reading Mode ('Modalità Lettura') with exact scientific parity to the 3D scroll route.
Implement an isolated 3D Model Gallery Viewer modal with orbit, pan, zoom, model switcher, and scientific stats.

Build the Admin Analytics & Error-Log Dashboard with passcode auth ('climate2026'), Recharts/Shadcn data visualizations (scene engagement duration, mode selection ratios), and interactive WebGL error log filter.
Add scientific references (IPCC AR6, NASA GISS, NOAA, WMO) and credit footer: 'Prodotto da Studio Rocchetti Comunicazione'.
Ensure mandatory data-testid attributes on all interactive elements: buttons, toggles, timeline markers, navigation items, modal controls, and inputs.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and ensure complete keyboard accessibility (tabbing, Esc to close modals, clear visible focus rings).

accessibility_and_performance.data_testid_convention: kebab-case identifier matching role (e.g., data-testid='header-timeline-button', data-testid='scene-indicator-badge', data-testid='sound-toggle-button', data-testid='reading-mode-toggle', data-testid='model-gallery-button', data-testid='reset-camera-button', data-testid='admin-login-button')
accessibility_and_performance.webgl_fallback: Includes automatic performance detection; falls back to animated canvas/2D depth layers if WebGL is unavailable or low FPS detected.
accessibility_and_performance.keyboard_navigation: Full focus ring styling (`focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#66D9EF]`), ESC key listener for all modals and drawers.
